# Escala type roles

Two layers. **Primitives**: two families, four weights, one size scale with its line-height and derived tracking. **Roles**: each role aliases a family + size + weight PER VIEWPORT. Components and screens use roles only.

- **CSS** five facets per role, plus `-tablet` / `-mobile` twins: `--text-<role>-font-family`, `--text-<role>-font-size`, `--text-<role>-font-weight`, `--text-<role>-line-height`, `--text-<role>-letter-spacing` (e.g. `--text-button-font-size`, `--text-heading-lg-font-size-mobile`).
- **Figma** text style `Type/<role>` (`Type/label`); the `Typography` collection carries `role/<role>/size|weight|family|line-height|letter-spacing` with modes Desktop · Tablet · Mobile.
- **Recipes / tokens.json** `type.<role>` and `typography.roles`.

## Display

Page-level statements. One per screen.

| Role | CSS | Figma | Desktop | Tablet | Mobile | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type.display` | `--text-display-*` | `Type/display` | display-xl · bold · heading font | display-lg · bold · heading font | display-md · bold · heading font | Hero and page titles. |

## Heading

Section titles. Body family by default — size and semibold carry the hierarchy.

| Role | CSS | Figma | Desktop | Tablet | Mobile | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type.heading-xl` | `--text-heading-xl-*` | `Type/heading-xl` | display-lg · semibold | display-md · semibold | display-sm · semibold | Largest section title. |
| `type.heading-lg` | `--text-heading-lg-*` | `Type/heading-lg` | display-md · semibold | display-sm · semibold | display-xs · semibold | Primary section heading. |
| `type.heading-md` | `--text-heading-md-*` | `Type/heading-md` | display-sm · semibold | display-xs · semibold | text-xl · semibold | Card and panel titles. |
| `type.heading-sm` | `--text-heading-sm-*` | `Type/heading-sm` | display-xs · semibold | text-xl · semibold | text-lg · semibold | Nested headings and list titles. |
| `type.heading-xs` | `--text-heading-xs-*` | `Type/heading-xs` | text-xl · semibold | text-lg · semibold | text-md · semibold | Overline-scale titles still read as headings. |
| `type.heading-2xs` | `--text-heading-2xs-*` | `Type/heading-2xs` | text-lg · semibold | text-md · semibold | text-md · semibold | Smallest heading (h6). Sits one rung above body. |

## Primitives

**Families:** `--font-family-heading` (heading / display) · `--font-family-body` (body, headings by default).

**Weights:** `--font-weight-regular` 400 · `--font-weight-medium` 500 · `--font-weight-semibold` 600 · `--font-weight-bold` 700 (each with an `-italic` row in Figma).

| Size step | Font size | Line height | Tracking |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-xs` | 12px | 18px | 0px |
| `text-sm` | 14px | 20px | 0px |
| `text-md` | 16px | 24px | 0px |
| `text-lg` | 18px | 28px | 0px |
| `text-xl` | 20px | 30px | -0.2px |
| `display-xs` | 24px | 32px | -0.4px |
| `display-sm` | 30px | 38px | -0.6px |
| `display-md` | 36px | 44px | -0.7px |
| `display-lg` | 48px | 60px | -1px |
| `display-xl` | 60px | 72px | -1.2px |
| `display-2xl` | 72px | 90px | -1.4px |

CSS: `--font-size-<step>`, `--line-height-<step>`, `--letter-spacing-<step>`. Tracking is derived from the size, never stored. The Text size dial scales every step and its leading by one factor, so the rhythm survives.
